transform_image_edit_request: transform an image edit request into the provider-specific format with model, prompt, image and optional params
transform_image_edit_response: transform a raw httpx image edit response into a standardized ImageResponse object
map_openai_params: map OpenAI-style image edit optional parameters to provider-specific parameters
validate_environment: validate the environment by checking that required headers and API keys are configured
get_config: get the configuration dictionary from a BaseImageEditConfig subclass excluding methods and private attributes
